record.title: DiffMS: Diffusion Generation of Molecules Conditioned on Mass Spectra
record.reason: Include under the approved primary-biomedical computational-metabolomics scope. The central problem is de novo structural elucidation of unidentified compounds from tandem mass spectra, with explicit metabolite-dark-matter motivation and substantive experimental-spectrum evaluation on GNPS-derived NPLIB1 and MassSpecGym. The method is designed for spectrum-conditioned structure identification rather than generic unconstrained molecule generation. HMDB and COCONUT are among four decoder-pretraining sources, and validation/test molecules from both benchmarks are excluded; pretraining provenance alone is not the inclusion criterion. This is computational metabolomics infrastructure, with no clinical endpoint, confirmed new-metabolite discovery or therapeutic-function claim. The earlier exclusion applied an unnecessarily restrictive clinical/biological-endpoint requirement and is revised only through this separate addendum.
